# Coverage

What `@awacloud/oconv-fonts` is measured against. The package ships vendored font files and the descriptor that registers them, so only its code coverage is measured here; the faces themselves are read by `@awacloud/fonts`, whose page covers the font parsing, and the PDF files they end up in are measured on `@awacloud/oconv`'s page.
